name: vertical-topdown
description: C35 vertical 144x224 mode: Sample Town topdown walk from (50,50), world-space fields only. The GB route's d-pad is sent to the WSC Y pad.

excluded.why: the WSC vertical viewport is 144x224 and the GB viewport is 160x144; camera and scroll are compared through the 144x224 clamp, not raw
the two viewports overlap but are not identical, so activation is required to match only inside the overlap
